nodes.name: Daily 0600 MT Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires at 12:00 UTC = 06:00 MT. Triggers lifecycle scheduler daily.

nodes.name: Run Lifecycle Scheduler
nodes.notes: Runs lifecycle_scheduler.py. Creates Gmail DRAFTS only — never sends. Drafts labeled THUNDERBIRD-Commander-Review.

parameters.command: python3 /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/thunderbird_telegram_gw.py --message '🦅 ETB-003 Lifecycle Scheduler — FAILED. Check OpsCenter/logs/lifecycle_audit.jsonl. Retry 1/3.' 2>&1 || true

nodes.name: Telegram Error Alert
nodes.notes: Sends Telegram alert to Commander on scheduler failure.

parameters.command: python3 /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/thunderbird_telegram_gw.py --message '🦅 ETB-003 Lifecycle Scheduler — OK. Audit: OpsCenter/logs/lifecycle_audit.jsonl' 2>&1 || true

nodes.name: Telegram Success Ack
nodes.notes: Success acknowledgment — only fires if no drafts created (silent days).
